# rustinion_device_log_collection (Resource)

Manages one device's log collection override (same keys as rustinion_group_log_collection; absent = inherit from the group; `files` are added to the group's). Destroying the resource removes the override.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `settings_json` (String) The settings as a JSON object (jsonencode). Validated by the server.
- `target_id` (String) The device id.

### Read-Only

- `effective_json` (String) What the device's devices actually run with (defaults and inheritance applied).
- `id` (String) Same as target_id.
